'''''The Unending Stars: Meditations on an Ilum Pilgrimage''''' was a text commonly studied by [[Jedi Consular]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]]<ref name="TORE" /> in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The title of the text related to unending [[Star/Legends|stars]] and [[Meditation/Legends|meditations]] on a pilgrimage to [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], an isolated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] sacred to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Under starry skies, the [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)/Legends|Ilum Temple]] served as a serene haven for Jedi pilgrims who made their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] with local [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]] and meditated on Ilum's unique bond to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="TORE" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The Unending Stars: Meditations on an Ilum Pilgrimage'' was introduced in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="TORE" />
